subtitle: Slow natural recovery of palms and coconuts for long games.
description: Adds slow natural recovery for palm ecology and coconuts so long-term survival does not turn island resources into permanently exhausted one-time supplies.
features: Real palm trees participate in a shared world population model.
Empty palms can naturally produce coconuts again after long in-game periods.
Coconut recovery works for both native world palms and managed palms created by the mod.
Decorative YOUNG_PALM harvest plants are not treated as full tree stages.
Local split-screen uses one shared ecology for both players rather than per-player state.
The ecology model accounts for unloaded islands and supports game-time catch-up.
Mod state is persisted separately and restored with the corresponding game world.

faq.question: Does this turn palms into fast farms?
faq.answer: No. The goal is rare long-term natural recovery, not a constant guaranteed resource stream.

faq.question: Does each split-screen player have a separate ecology?
faq.answer: No. Both players share the same world ecology.

faq.question: Do YOUNG_PALM plants count as tree stages?
faq.answer: No. The mod distinguishes the harvest plants from the real PALM_1–PALM_4 tree stages.

faq.question: What happens on unloaded islands?
faq.answer: The mod keeps an ecology model and applies game-time catch-up when needed.

faq.question: Where is the extra state stored?
faq.answer: In a separate mod persistence sidecar associated with the game world/save.
